executive_summary.headline: Shipping chokepoints severely constrained and energy costs elevated; multiple suppliers saw unexplained double-digit declines Tuesday, now stabilizing.
executive_summary.next_step: Confirm whether Tuesday's semiconductor and battery supplier price moves (Texas Instruments, Infineon, EVE Energy, Jabil) share a common catalyst—earnings, guidance revision, or supply chain comment—within 24 hours.
executive_summary.context: Strait of Hormuz transits down 95% year-over-year and Bab el-Mandeb down 31%, combined with EU natural gas 131% above baseline and aluminium 23% above baseline, are driving world pillar to AMBER. Texas Instruments, Infineon and EVE Energy (all high exposure) fell 6–10% on 24–25 Nov with no corroborating news; cause remains unconfirmed but timing across multiple suppliers suggests checking for a shared external trigger rather than individual company events.
